CustomField.description: Calculates the grade approved by Zeta based on the student’s applied grade, Zeta decision, and student type. Returning students and PK–1 students retain their applied grade.
CustomField.formula:
IF( OR( TEXT(Grade_Applied__c) = "PK", TEXT(Grade_Applied__c) = "K", TEXT(Grade_Applied__c) = "1", TEXT(Zeta_Decision__c) = "Remain in Applied Grade", TEXT(LearnerAccount.Student_Type__c) = "Returning" ), TEXT(Grade_Applied__c),
IF( TEXT(Zeta_Decision__c) = "Retain/Holdover", TEXT( VALUE(TEXT(Grade_Applied__c)) - 1 ), TEXT(Grade_Applied__c) & " (not yet assessed)" ) )
CustomField.label: Zeta Approved Grade
